>>> help
Command groups:
  analytics     Anonymous usage analytics inspection
  build         Build and preview operations
  debug         Debug variables and output packets
  device        Device (node) operations
  export        Export operations (Pro)
  group         Device group operations
  param         Parameter operations
  project       Project file operations
  scene         Scene/render extent operations
  snapshot      Snapshot operations (Pro)
  system        System operations
  update        Auto-updater control and diagnostics
  wire          Connection/wiring operations

Top-level commands:
  alias         Define or list user aliases (Pro)
  clear         Clear console output
  echo          Print text to the console
  help          Show help for commands
  run           Execute commands from a script file (Pro)
  unalias       Remove a user alias (Pro)

Shortcuts:
  add           -> device add
  connect       -> wire connect
  delete        -> device delete
  devices       -> device list
  disconnect    -> wire disconnect
  exit          -> system quit
  get           -> param get
  groups        -> group list
  info          -> system info
  open          -> project open
  preview       -> build preview
  purge         -> system purge
  quit          -> system quit
  redo          -> project redo
  save          -> project save
  select        -> device select
  set           -> param set
  snapshots     -> snapshot list
  stop          -> build stop
  undo          -> project undo

Type 'help <group>' for commands within a group.
<<<
>>> help param
param commands:
  param get [device.]<param>      Get a parameter value
  param list [device]             List parameters of a device
  param set [device.]<param> <value>  Set a parameter value

<<<
>>> help device
device commands:
  device add <type>               Add a new device
  device bypass <name>            Toggle bypass on a device
  device delete <name>            Delete a device
  device disable <name>           Disable a device
  device enable <name>            Enable a device
  device info                     Show info about selected device
  device list [filter]            List all devices
  device organize                 Organize devices by processing order
  device rename <oldname> <newname>  Rename a device
  device select <name>            Select a device by name

<<<
>>> help wire
wire commands:
  wire connect <source>[.port] <dest>[.port]  Connect an output to an input
  wire disconnect <source>[.port] <dest>[.port]  Remove a connection
  wire list <device>              List connections for a device

<<<
>>> help scene
scene commands:
  scene list                      List all scenes/render extents
  scene lock [on|off]             Lock/unlock scene
  scene name [name]               Get or set the current scene name
  scene origin <x_km> <y_km>      Set scene center position
  scene resolution [value|up|down] [count]  Get or set render resolution
  scene select <index|name>       Select a scene by index or name
  scene show                      Show current scene info
  scene size [width_km height_km]  Show or set scene dimensions

<<<
>>> help project
project commands:
  project close [force]           Close the current project
  project new [blank|default|force]  Create a new project
  project open <path> [force]     Open a project file
  project redo                    Redo the last undone action
  project save [path]             Save the current project
  project undo                    Undo the last action

<<<
